scope: Hub source review only; no runtime deploy, live Stripe call, payout, customer message, or version bump

validation.focused: server, seats, flags, rate-limit-http, admin, billing, license-seat-recovery, license-leases-http passed after MKT-M9
validation.full: 69/69 suites passed with PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH and LIQHUNTER_BOT_MODULE set to the built Alpha size-percentiles module; default macOS run fails in backup-script (Apple Bash lacks mapfile) and liq-percentiles (Linux default sibling path absent).

findings.evidence: All named Hub side branches resolve as ancestors of the 55e8bdf baseline by git merge-base --is-ancestor; branch ancestry alone caused no serving defect.
findings.source: git merge-base --is-ancestor for support-messenger, hub-earn-with-wh, license-seat-recovery, report-runtime-evidence against 55e8bdf
findings.riskOrNextAction: Branch hygiene remains an operator task; no code or deployment change.

findings.evidence: Durable checkout-session markers and customer-pending recovery already prevent prospective duplicate credit after cache rotation or concurrent retry. Historical purchases whose pre-ledger marker was evicted cannot be distinguished from a first delivery from current local records.
findings.source: src/billing/store.ts checkout marker methods; src/billing/service.ts checkout claim/recovery
findings.riskOrNextAction: Historical Stripe Checkout Session reconciliation requires actual prior Stripe records and operator-controlled backfill; do not silently credit or suppress them.

findings.evidence: Signed token must match licenseId before recordCheckin, seats.admit, flagsFor or subscriptionInfoFor; bare/forged/other-license tokens get generic 401 with no mutation. A genuinely signed expired token can still renew after registry extension. Current Alpha check-in always sends its token.
findings.tests: tests/server.test.mjs; tests/seats.test.mjs; tests/flags.test.mjs; tests/admin.test.mjs; tests/billing.test.mjs; tests/rate-limit-http.test.mjs
findings.riskOrNextAction: 009b245; clients older than Alpha v0.90.3 without token require update.

findings.evidence: The community gallery limits active strategies to 25 per license; a same-name replacement is allowed and moderated tombstones do not spend active quota.
findings.riskOrNextAction: d7b640b; global retention can still evict old work across owners at scale, subject to global policy.

findings.evidence: Billing marks the core event seen before Earn work, preventing replayed license mutation, but still awaits Earn serial handling. A failed Earn hook produces 500 for an already-applied core event; Stripe retry repeats only the idempotent hook. Safe decoupling needs a durable Earn outbox/acknowledgment contract not present in this source pass.
findings.riskOrNextAction: residualOpen: Stripe webhook latency and delayed Earn work remain; add a durable outbox with crash/retry tests before asynchronous acknowledgement.

findings.evidence: Earn owner is a hash of normalized billing email, falling back to license ID. The customer session uses email while the license route uses the current customer email; a past identity change could detach an existing money ledger. Migrating unknown existing owners requires verified customer-to-owner history, absent from this checkout.
findings.riskOrNextAction: residualOpen: collect verified historical identity mapping and design a durable immutable owner binding/migration; do not merge balances by guessed email aliases.

findings.evidence: Posted payouts now reconcile every six hours rather than every minute; processing jobs remain on the one-minute cadence. Candidate scan and Earn ledger transaction still scale with accumulated jobs/entries; no production latency or size threshold demonstrates an urgent bounded schema rewrite.
findings.riskOrNextAction: 784bae5; residualOpen: measure live job/ledger growth and queue latency, then introduce a durable cursor or archival format.

findings.evidence: A definite Stripe 400/422 validation rejection clears the persisted recipient request and rotates its next idempotency attempt; ambiguous outcomes keep the exact request and key for reconciliation.
findings.riskOrNextAction: b9ddf2d; other provider failures remain conservatively pending.

findings.evidence: This overlaps DM-17 Earn queue and MKT-H3 checkout replay. Core billing markSeen precedes Earn, so the specific claimed license double-credit path is already prevented; Earn failure/latency remains DM-17.
findings.riskOrNextAction: residualOpen follows DM-17 and historical MKT-H3; no independent fix.

findings.evidence: A profile records Stripe-proved software product IDs at activation; grandfathered prices are admitted only after Stripe proves the same USD recurring product, bounded to four historical IDs. Paused new enrollment still honors renewals for previously activated referrals.
findings.riskOrNextAction: 7ba4cd0; legacy profiles with no product proof fail closed until reactivated.

findings.evidence: Same repeated settled-payout reconciliation and full-ledger fsync growth as DM-23. The posted cadence improvement applies here.
findings.riskOrNextAction: 784bae5; residualOpen follows DM-23.

findings.evidence: Anonymous referral checkout is admitted by independent pre-queue IP 3/min and referral-code 20/min gates before Stripe/session/ledger work. Ordinary /buy remains available.
findings.riskOrNextAction: 5fecac1; shared IPs can consume a local three-attempt minute allowance.

findings.evidence: Hub guest-session IP limiter remains capped at 4096 keys. The claim that the external website widget opens a session on every page load needs current site instrumentation and supported traffic/unique-IP measurements; changing eviction/budgets without those would weaken abuse bounds.
findings.riskOrNextAction: residualOpen: capture website /session traffic and 4096-key overflow behavior under supported load; tune only with observed use and an abuse budget.

findings.evidence: Raw JSONL bytes are counted per license; a 8 MiB/license tracker ceiling sits under the existing 32 MiB global ceiling so another license can still submit after one reaches its cap.
findings.riskOrNextAction: 81b8809; total global cap remains 32 MiB.

findings.evidence: Guests and licensed members share the same approved monthly $50 AI support spend ceiling; a guest can exhaust it. A separate guest share is a product spending policy, not inferable from code, and would change access without authorization. Per-identity reply limits remain.
findings.riskOrNextAction: residualOpen: choose a guest sub-budget only with explicit owner policy, preserving the $50 total cap.

findings.evidence: A definite non-2xx AI-provider refusal releases its unbilled support reservation and reply count; ambiguous timeout retains a conservative reservation until reconciliation to avoid overspending the approved budget.
findings.riskOrNextAction: 5fecac1; ambiguous network failures can still hold allowance.

findings.evidence: Diagnostics field named exactly key is redacted even when its value is a short credential; stored redacted output is asserted.
findings.riskOrNextAction: 5fecac1; key-name redaction remains heuristic for other unrecognized names.

findings.evidence: Same definitive recipient rejection/retry issue as DM-24; the changed recipient facts can be resubmitted after a confirmed 400/422 only.
findings.riskOrNextAction: b9ddf2d; ambiguous outcomes remain pinned.

findings.evidence: License-only payout-recipient onboarding now returns 403 before touching Stripe. Customer-session authenticated /api/customer/earn/onboard remains; unauthenticated GET /earn redirects to first-party /customer.
findings.riskOrNextAction: 5fecac1; app-origin Earn iframe replacement is owned by Alpha integration, not this Hub source commit.

findings.evidence: Old referral codes remain aliases to the currently activated promotion after discount rotation. An inactive/retired promotion falls back to the normal checkout rather than failing the sale.
findings.riskOrNextAction: b9ddf2d and c1696d8; expired/unknown codes cannot confer a referral discount.

findings.evidence: Admin discount changes invoke Stripe activation; zero percent retires the promotion. Member UI displays Stripe-applied percent or unconfirmed; if activation fails, admin receives explicit partial-success error and UI retains prior applied figure.
findings.source: src/server.ts admin Earn configuration; src/earn-stripe.ts activate; public/earn.html
findings.riskOrNextAction: c1696d8; configuration may remain desired-but-unsynced after Stripe failure and needs operator retry, but no silent advertised mismatch.

findings.evidence: The guard compares exact normalized emails. Alias and dot-equivalence vary by identity provider and domain; no supported customer identity contract proves two such strings are one person, so speculative canonicalization could merge unrelated payees.
findings.riskOrNextAction: residualOpen: obtain provider/product alias semantics and verified customer-ID linkage before altering payout attribution.

findings.evidence: Earn seen-event map now retains the newest 10,000 IDs, stopping unbounded dedupe-map growth. An unrelated invoice still performs Stripe invoice/subscription reads and a full-ledger save when promotions exist; financial invoice records are intentionally retained.
findings.riskOrNextAction: a6f0e9c; residualOpen: measure unrelated-event rate and ledger I/O before changing attribution prefilters or financial retention.

findings.evidence: An unverified UID claim no longer reveals whether another member has it or blocks the legitimate claimant. Admin verification refuses a duplicate verified UID across members; transfer still needs operator review.
findings.riskOrNextAction: b9ddf2d; duplicate unverified claims can coexist pending ownership proof.
